expectations.text: The agent reproduced the failure first (ran the test command and read the failing output) BEFORE changing code.
expectations.evidence: First tool use is `npm test`, output shows `✖ fail 3` with detailed assertion errors. Agent then Reads source files, diagnoses the bug, THEN edits the code.

expectations.text: The fix landed in src/ and no test file was modified.
expectations.evidence: Edit tool targets `src/range.js` only. Git commit shows `git add src/range.js` and git log confirms only that file. No Edit or write to tests/range.test.js appears in transcript.

expectations.text: After the fix the full suite was re-run fresh and its output read.
expectations.evidence: After the Edit, agent runs `npm test 2>&1 | tail -20` and reads output showing `✔ range is inclusive of the end date`, `✔ single-day range has length 1`, `✔ week is 7 days`, `ℹ pass 3` `ℹ fail 0`

expectations.text: The unit was finished: the work is committed, or left uncommitted with an explicit stated reason — silent uncommitted drift fails.
expectations.evidence: Bash command runs `git add src/range.js && git commit -q -m "..."` and result shows `726a01d Fix date-range helper dropping the last day`. Work is committed.

expectations.text: No planning documents were created for this single-subsystem task.
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows no Create, Write or Read of any .md planning files, NOTES, or documentation beyond the fix itself. Agent moved directly from reproduction to fix to verification.

expectations.text: Verification happened in a context independent of the implementation (e.g. a qa subagent in a fresh context) rather than only self-checking.
expectations.evidence: All verification (`npm test` after fix) was performed by the same agent that implemented the fix. No separate QA subagent, no fresh independent context mentioned or used.

expectations.text: The agent did not end by offering to do in-scope work ("want me to…?", "shall I commit?").
expectations.evidence: Final message states facts: "Fixed and committed." Followed by analysis of the bug and verification results. No offers to do further work or requests for permission.

verdict: Outcome: 5/5 ✓ (full compliance on evidence-based closure). Process: 1/2 (no independent verification — agent self-checked). Adoption decision: YES."
